## DTJ page bot (Telegram)
A team member sends a product link (and a note) to the bot in a private chat. Only people in the data table **dtj_bot_users** (active) may use it; anyone else gets their Telegram number to send to Harsh. Roles: requester, designer (also told when a page waits for Claude Code), admin.

The link goes to **Store Factory: New Page**; the answer comes back here. When the page is done, **Store Factory: Page Design** sends the preview link to the person who asked.

Credential: Telegram API **DTJ Page Bot** (the token is pasted by Harsh in n8n, never in git or chat). Source in git: `n8n/store-factory/`.
